eps.t: A Tie Breaker and a Huge Mistake
eps.o: Tensions rise in the tire store when new co-owners Georgie and Ruben realize they can't agree on anything, and Jim struggles to find his purpose now that he's retired.

eps.t: Fan Mail and Old-Timey Organ Music
eps.o: Georgie's upset when Mandy's new role as weekend weather girl gets her more attention from the men in town, and Connor turns to Jim for help when he's asked to play the organ at the high school baseball game.

eps.t: A Will and a Dead Man’s Wife
eps.o: Georgie's not ready for his mother to start dating again. Meanwhile, Jim and Audrey struggle to make their wills.

eps.t: Dirty Hands and a Barbed-Wire Fence
eps.o: Georgie and Ruben are forced to get their hands dirty when Fred Fagenbacher tries to run them out of business. Meanwhile, Mandy grows suspicious of Georgie's lies.

eps.t: A Pregnancy Test and an Old Man’s Prostate
eps.o: Georgie's jealousy rears its head when Mandy gets sent on an overnight work trip with her ex and current boss, Scott. Meanwhile, Jim and Audrey panic when they find a pregnancy test in Connor's trash.

eps.t: Heartbreak and the Refuge of the Downtrodden
eps.o: Georgie, Mandy and the family do their best to lift Connor's spirits during a rough patch while Connor tries to figure out a plan for his life.

eps.t: A Bus Bench and Faith Out the Wazoo
eps.o: Audrey and Mary's rivalry resurfaces as Georgie seeks their help at the tire store, while Jim faces aging concerns after going to the DMV.

eps.t: Bitin', Spankin' and a Load of Yankee Psychobabble
eps.o: Georgie and Mandy get upset when Audrey disciplines CeeCee without their permission.

eps.t: Payback and a Partial Shebang
eps.o: Georgie's feud with a rival store threatens his partnership with Ruben. Meanwhile, Mandy finds out Georgie's been keeping secrets from her.

eps.t: Miami Beach and a Magical Family Christmas
eps.o: Georgie and Mandy struggle to balance work, family and the holidays when Audrey plans an unexpected Christmas vacation.

eps.t: A New Hobby, a Pervert and a Part-Time Job
eps.o: Audrey and Mandy urge Jim to find a new hobby now that he's retired and driving them crazy.

eps.t: The G Word and a Blaspheming Bimbo
eps.o: Mandy makes a controversial remark on live TV that puts her job, Georgie's business and the family's reputation at risk.

eps.t: A Big Birthday and Tequila Shots
eps.o: Mandy struggles to celebrate Georgie’s 21st birthday after hitting a rough patch in her career.

eps.t: Three Angry Women and a Prophylactic
eps.o: Mandy's attempt to help Missy with boys backfires when Mary finds out and Georgie is caught in the crossfire.

eps.t: A Stuffed Monkey and an Ex-Girlfriend
eps.o: When CeeCee loses her favorite toy, Mandy and Meemaw take it as an opportunity to make some money. Meanwhile, Connor contemplates revisiting an old relationship.

eps.t: Alpha Males and the Power of Prayer
eps.o: Mandy tries to make things right with Pastor Jeff when she learns her controversial comments have hurt the tire store's business. Meanwhile, Jim and Audrey butt heads over Connor's allowance.

eps.t: A Country Club, a Yokel and a New Boss
eps.o: Georgie's plan to make new clients at the local country club backfires when its outdated policies upset Audrey. Meanwhile, Mandy struggles to prove herself at work.

eps.t: A New Scoreboard and a Horse's You-Know-What
eps.o: Georgie and Fagenbacher go head to head when Fagenbacher tries to sabotage Georgie's attempt to honor his dad.

eps.t: A Little Schmoozin' and a Nose for the News
eps.o: Georgie's plan to get on the news sparks a feud between Mandy and a rival weathergirl. Meanwhile, Mandy tries to use the conflict to help her career.

eps.t: Splurges and Secrets
eps.o: A financial windfall leads Georgie to make a questionable purchase; Audrey and Jim butt heads over old secrets.

eps.t: Funky Chili and Friends Who Take Their Clothes Off
eps.o: Mandy and Jim butt heads when they take over the store for a sick Georgie and Ruben. Meanwhile, Audrey panics when Connor rekindles an old flame.

eps.t: A New Beau and Someone Else's Mom's House
eps.o: Georgie and Mandy take matters into their own hands when Mary starts warming up to Fagenbacher. Also, Audrey struggles to cope with Connor’s absence.
